incomingRepayments: Principal paid and interest paid are script outputs. In Loans!D1 records the last successful calculation, replacing the former dropdown.

outgoingRepaymentParameters.10M: 10M loan - emetway to treehouse - repayment date
outgoingRepaymentParameters.30M: 30M loan - emetway to treehouse - repayment date

outgoingRepaymentRule: Keep monthly principal and interest payment formulas. From the matching repayment month onward, pay the positive principal/interest owed; a blank date produces zero. The recalculation script does not write Out Loans.
plannedLoansControl: In Loans!A1; loan draw formulas reference $A$1
loanTotalLookupScope: Look up the matching total label within the relevant totals block. Exclude In Loans row 106 and Out Loans row 36, which link back to Cash Flow debt-service availability.
principalRepaymentStart: Params: principal loan repayment start month (preserved January 2029). Gates principal only.
interestRepaymentStart: Per loan: month of In Loans column C plus years in column G. Params displays Per loan contract. Interest eligibility is independent of principal eligibility; eligible interest retains priority and reserve limits.
